brief: Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure for this ageing unit, as it cannot be attended before the event [MG-023]. Where events extend beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward [MG-021]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period [MG-021].
